findings.evidence: "Muse Glimmer 30B ([2°][FACT], source: vLLM-Recipes, citing the Meta model card) is a dense 29.6B local-agentic model that runs in ~18 GB at ~5-bit weights [2°]."
findings.issue: Trailing bare [2°] tag is an Axis-1 label without its required Axis-2 companion. The Preface (page xv) states explicitly: "A label pair always takes one item from each of the first two axes, e.g. [1P][DERIVED] or [ILLUSTRATIVE][ASSUMPTION]" and "Every load-bearing quantitative claim carries Axes 1 and 2 as an inline pair." The quantity "~18 GB at ~5-bit weights" is load-bearing and carries only Axis 1.
findings.fix_instruction: Replace the trailing "[2°]" with a complete two-axis label pair, e.g. "[2°][FACT]" (if the value is stated by the vLLM-Recipes source) or "[2°][DERIVED]" (if the book derived it from model-card numbers).

findings.evidence: PDF p.75 (printed p.51): "It is not the largest KV constant in the book: Ch 7 §7.4 re-derives the per-token value for other geometries, where a 100-layer, 12,288-hidden model at FP16 gives ~4.9 MB/token." Preface, PDF p.23 (printed p.ix): "Do not repeat a chapter number after the chapter name — write Ch. 8 § 3 or § 8.3.3, not Ch. 8 § 8.3.3." and "§ N.M ... means Chapter N, Section M — so § 1.4 is Ch. 1, Section 4". Ch 1 (PDF p.31) cites the same chapter differently: "the standing FP8-KV qualifiers are consolidated in Ch. 7 §4 (the accounting-basis note)".
findings.issue: "Ch 7 §7.4" is the malformed form the Preface explicitly forbids: per the book's own convention it reads as "Ch 7, Section 7, Subsection 4", a target that does not exist, and the same chapter is cited elsewhere as "Ch. 7 §4" for a different purpose (the accounting-basis note). It is therefore unresolvable as written and conflicts with the cross-reference in Ch 1 — the reader cannot tell whether the intended target is Ch 7 Section 4 or the fourth subsection of Ch 7 Section 3 (where the per-token value for other geometries would sit).
findings.fix_instruction: Rewrite as "§ 7.3.4" if the target is the fourth subsection of Ch 7's Worked Example, or as "§ 7.4" if it is Chapter 7 Section 4 — never "Ch 7 §7.4" — and confirm the Ch 1 cross-reference ("Ch. 7 §4 (the accounting-basis note)") points at the same or a different section, describing each target's content unambiguously.

findings.evidence: PDF p.75 (printed p.51): "The model card [1P][FACT] ... is the Qwen4-architecture preview: 125B total / 6B active (plus a separate 51B of offloadable N-gram embedding parameters), 512 MoE experts (10 routed + 1 shared per token), and hybrid attention ... the weights that must be resident for Qwen are its total set, ~125 × 10⁹ params × 2 bytes/param ≈ 250 GB (plus the offloadable N-gram); of that total, only ~6 × 10⁹ params are read per batch-1 decode token, at 2 bytes/param = ~12 GB ... and the ~250 GB total (not the ~12 GB active working set) is what must be resident unless experts are explicitly offloaded."
findings.issue: The parameter accounting is internally ambiguous on the number the chapter calls load-bearing for sharding decisions. "125B total ... (plus a separate 51B of offloadable N-gram embedding parameters)" can be read as 125B inclusive of the 51B (125B total) or as 125B excluding it (176B total); the next sentence then calls "its total set" 125B and adds "(plus the offloadable N-gram)", which implies the second reading, and the later "the ~250 GB total ... is what must be resident" implies the first. A reader cannot tell whether resident weights are ~250 GB or ~352 GB — and the ~250 GB figure is the one used to argue "the difference between fitting on one host and sharding across several".
findings.fix_instruction: State the accounting once, unambiguously: e.g. "125B transformer parameters + a separate 51B of offloadable N-gram embedding parameters = 176B total, of which ~250 GB (the 125B transformer set) must be resident and the N-gram table is offloadable" — and adjust the "~250 GB total" and "~1/21 of Qwen's own total weight footprint (~250 GB → 12 GB)" sentences to match whichever reading is intended.
